fire: The ferry was cancelled because of heavy seas in the channel.
Surfers waited beyond the breakers for the next big set of waves.
Foam from the breaking surf hissed up the sand and over our feet.
Wind-driven waves pounded the breakwater for most of the night.
The return was almost three standard deviations above its historical mean.
Numerically the complementary error function erfc(z) is more stable for large z.
Salt spray from the rough sea coated every window of the lighthouse.
The sea was choppy, with white-capped waves slapping the hull.
quiet: The ferry was cancelled because of thick fog in the harbour.
Skaters waited by the rink for the next big session of the day.
Water from the burst pipe ran across the floor and over our feet.
Heavy rain pounded the tin roof for most of the night.
The return was almost three percentage points above last year's figure.
Numerically the trapezoidal rule is more stable than naive summation for long series.
Mud from the flooded river coated every window of the mill.
The lake was glassy, with ducks drifting near the reeds.
